controles.affirmation: En mars 2026 le MPSC a accorde une hausse tarifaire annuelle de 277 M$ sur un ROE autorise de 9,90%, contre 10,25% demandes par Consumers
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2026, the MPSC issued an order stating an annual rate increase of $277 million, based on a 9.90-percent authorized return on equity (10-Q T2 2026). Le ROE demande figure Note 2 : 'Consumers refined its request in October 2025, requesting an annual rate increase of $423 million, based on a 10.25-percent authorized return on equity'.
controles.correction_proposee: Citer la Note 2 (dossier electrique 2025, demande de 423 M$ a 10,25%) et non le passage du dossier 2026. Mentionner aussi l'errata d'avril 2026 : 'On a corrected basis, Consumers' rate increase reflected in the MPSC's order was $217 million'.

controles.affirmation: En juin 2026 Consumers a depose un nouveau dossier tarifaire electricite demandant 481 M$ sur la base d'un ROE de 10,25%
controles.verbatim_source: In June 2026, Consumers filed an application with the MPSC seeking a rate increase of $481 million made up of two components. First, Consumers requested a $456 million annual rate increase, based on a 10.25-percent return on equity [...] Second, Consumers requested approval of a $25 million surcharge
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser que le ROE de 10,25% porte sur la composante de 456 M$, le solde de 25 M$ etant une surtaxe de rattrapage.

controles.affirmation: Sur le dossier gaz depose en decembre 2025, Consumers a revu sa demande de 240 M$ a 232 M$ avant la decision du regulateur
controles.verbatim_source: In December 2025, Consumers filed an application with the MPSC seeking an annual rate increase of $240 million based on a 10.25-percent authorized return on equity [...] In June 2026, Consumers revised its requested increase to $232 million.

controles.affirmation: J.H. Campbell (1 407 MW) devait fermer en mai 2025, cinq ordres d'urgence 202(c) successifs, pas de tarif MISO approuve par la FERC au 28 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: there is not currently a FERC-approved MISO Tariff for recovery of compliance costs associated with the continued operation of J.H. Campbell, and continued operation of J.H. Campbell is not contemplated in Consumers' current MPSC rates or rate filings at the MPSC. Consumers is pursuing cost recovery at FERC but cannot predict the outcome of those efforts (10-K FY2025, Item 1A, data-lake/CMS/_risks_src_30k.txt). Le 10-Q T2 2026 confirme le fond : 'MISO submitted a revised compliance filing in April 2026 and FERC approval of that filing remains pending' et 'the U.S. Secretary of Energy has issued four additional emergency orders' apres l'ordre initial de mai 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Corriger la source : le verbatim vient du 10-K FY2025 Item 1A, pas du 10-Q T2 2026. Le 10-Q T2 2026 ne contient pas cette phrase.

controles.affirmation: Benefice net disponible pour les actionnaires ordinaires de 198 M$ a 117 M$ au T2 2026, -40,9% ; 455 M$ contre 500 M$ sur six mois
controles.verbatim_source: Net Income Available to Common Stockholders $ 117 $ 198 $ (81) $ 455 $ 500 $ (45)

controles.affirmation: Le BPA dilue recule de 0,67 $ a 0,37 $ (-43,9%)
controles.verbatim_source: Basic Earnings Per Average Common Share $ 0.38 $ 0.67 $ (0.29) ; Diluted Earnings Per Average Common Share $ 0.37 $ 0.66 $ (0.29)
controles.correction_proposee: Le BPA dilue recule de 0,66 $ a 0,37 $ (-43,9%). Le 0,67 $ est le BPA de base du T2 2025, pas le BPA dilue.

controles.affirmation: Les emissions d'actions au T2 2026 bondissent de 2485,7% (362 M$), via des accords de vente a terme portant sur 6,4 millions d'actions a 75,63 $ en moyenne
controles.verbatim_source: During the six months ended June 30, 2026, CMS Energy entered into forward sale agreements for approximately 6.4 million shares at a weighted average initial forward price of $75.63 per share
controles.correction_proposee: Les 6,4 millions d'actions sont un cumul sur six mois, pas un chiffre du seul T2 2026. Ecrire : 'sur le premier semestre 2026, des accords de vente a terme portant sur environ 6,4 millions d'actions a 75,63 $ en moyenne'. Le +2485,7% (362 M$ au T2) reste conforme a la serie equity_issuance_q de kpis-haut.
